_comment: Per-campaign cost ledger for the real run. It keeps the owner's four money states apart (§1) and carries the 20% floor explicitly, so 'we did not go below the floor' is a checkable row rather than a claim.

account_ref.description: A local opaque reference. Never an account id, email, key, key hash or key length.

meter.description: The unit the ceiling is enforced in. Units are never summed across each other.

b0.description: Fixed initial available balance for the campaign, as a decimal string. It is observed ONCE and reused for the whole campaign; it is not re-derived from the running balance.

b0_source.description: Environment variables, documentation prices, mocked tools and credential-file presence are NOT in this enum: §1.1 says none of them is evidence of a balance.

floor.description: max(0.20*B0, provider minimum), rounded up for indivisible credit units. For tinyfish the provider minimum is US$0.20.

max_cumulative_drawdown.description: 0.80*B0 — an upper bound, not a target.

meter_trust.description: Anything other than 'verified' forbids a chargeable operation (§1.6).

in_flight_or_unknown_exposure.description: Reserved-but-unsettled plus dispatched-UNKNOWN, counted against the ceiling like real spend.

external_account_spend.description: Usage by other users of the same account during the campaign, when observable.

reserved.description: Quota reservation, in the provider's meter.

derived.description: Charge derived from usage after the fact.

actual.description: Provider-reported actual. Null means not confirmed — never treated as zero.

floor_after.description: current_available minus this operation, checked against the floor before dispatch.

usd_per_accepted_row.description: Null when no row was accepted; never zero.

floor_breached.description: True if any provider ended below its floor. Must be false.
